rationale: The stock gapped down ~23% on what appears to be a post-earnings reaction despite positive news, and is now sitting at 88% of today's range near the session high after recovering from $11.62 — the easy bounce money has largely been made. Price is pressing against today's high ($12.43) with the last five 1-minute candles showing stalling/distribution (declining closes, rising volume on the most recent bar suggesting absorption rather than breakout), making a long entry here high-risk. A short against a 23% gap-down recovery with strong fundamental news and 7x relative volume is equally unattractive; the risk/reward in either direction is unclear at this inflection point.
